author: Minecraft
description:
Wackadoo! Bluey is coming to Minecraft in the Bluey DLC. Get ready for fun as you track down hidden keys to explore Bluey’s family home and play games like I-Spy, Hide and Seek, and Ragdoll. Remember to look for some of Bluey, Bingo, Mum and Dad’s favourite things to unlock even more games and surprises. But first make sure to stop by Minecraft Marketplace for your free Chattermax Mask!

Read more: https://www.minecraft.net/article/blueys-house
title: Minecraft x Bluey DLC Launch Trailer
